name: ue-agent-accelerator
description: The layered memory stack for running coding agents on Unreal Engine codebases, and the benchmark that measures whether it helps.

plugins.name: ue-memory-stack
plugins.description: Generates what an Unreal codebase actually looks like at runtime - reflection specifiers, replication conditions and Blueprint-to-C++ edges - into files small enough to read, and tells an agent which one answers which question.

plugins.name: ue-memory-bench
plugins.description: The paired benchmark behind the stack's published numbers: question generation from your own artefacts, a clean-room baseline arm, multi-pass judging, and the method notes that say what each figure is allowed to mean.
